scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.test:server: node --import tsx --test src/server/index.test.ts src/server/devices.test.ts src/server/requests.test.ts src/server/notifications.test.ts src/server/waiting/detect.test.ts src/server/waiting/watcher.test.ts
scripts.preview: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production tsx src/server/index.ts
scripts.mobile:build: npm run mobile:build:ios && npm run mobile:build:watch
scripts.native:doctor: npm run native:manifest && node scripts/check-native-toolchain.mjs && cd native && ../node_modules/.bin/zero-native doctor --manifest app.zon --web-engine system
scripts.native:build: npm run native:manifest && node scripts/check-native-toolchain.mjs && cd native && zig build -Dzero-native-path=../node_modules/zero-native
scripts.native:run: npm run native:manifest && node scripts/check-native-toolchain.mjs && cd native && zig build run -Dzero-native-path=../node_modules/zero-native
